clue.text: Soothing application can save father suffering

indicators.note: suffering suggests the words are in distress and so knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A man in pain could be eased by a balm, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' rearranges SAVE and FATHER; 'can' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A scented lotion splashed on after a razor is applied to calm the skin.

clue.text: Sell during a round of golf

indicators.note: round of suggests the letters of the following word are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone does business while out on the golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round of' rearranges GOLF; 'during a' is a link. To flog is informal British for to sell.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British slang for vending goods, often hard-pushed.

clue.text: Tracts of eastern and southern states

parts.note: states as a verb means says

explanation.surface: Pamphlets about the eastern and southern parts of a country.
explanation.definitionFit: A tract is a short written treatise, just like a composition on a topic.

clue.text: Force one to hang about instead of going to work

definitions.text: Force one to hang about instead of going to work

parts.words: Force one to hang about instead of going to work
parts.note: both to make something dangle and to bar an employee from their job pending inquiry

explanation.surface: An employee is made to loiter rather than head to the office.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers hanging an object up and barring a worker temporarily from duties.

clue.text: The pin of a revolver?

parts.note: not a gun's firing pin but the line round which any rotating thing turns

explanation.surface: Asks about a component of a handgun.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotating body spins about a central line or spindle.

clue.text: Give a subject a title, perhaps

definitions.text: Give a subject a title, perhaps

parts.words: Give a subject a title, perhaps
parts.note: reads like naming an essay topic, but means a monarch raising a subject to the peerage

explanation.surface: Advice on heading a piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise someone to the nobility, conferring a rank such as baron.

clue.text: Gets blooming old

parts.note: a plant that flowers and then sets seed, and figuratively a person going shabby with age

explanation.surface: Someone moans about ageing, with 'blooming' as a mild oath.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means deteriorating from neglect or age, like a plant past flowering.

clue.text: Pacific islanders cash crop?

parts.note: bread is slang for cash and a fruit is a crop, giving a staple tree food of the Pacific

explanation.surface: Asks what export earns money for people on Pacific islands.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy tropical tree food grown and eaten across Polynesia.

clue.text: Tom's euphoric vibes

parts.note: a tom is a male cat, and its contented vibrating throat sound

explanation.surface: Someone called Tom is feeling a happy atmosphere.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat's low contented rumble.

clue.text: Devilish control

parts.note: the state of a person whose body is taken over by a demon

explanation.surface: Fiendishly tight management.
explanation.definitionFit: Demonic ownership of a person's soul, also simply ownership or control.

clue.text: Lines going to a ship back in port

parts.note: lines of verse can be an ode

indicators.note: back tells us the short pieces for a and ship are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: Ropes are attached to a vessel returning to harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Odessa is a major Black Sea harbour city in Ukraine.

clue.text: Countryman gives vegetables to a worker

parts.note: peas are vegetables
an ant is a worker, as in a worker ant

explanation.surface: A rural man hands over produce to a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: A small farmer or rural labourer.

clue.text: Stop on the main route?

parts.note: the main is the sea, so a stop on a sea voyage

explanation.surface: Asks about a stopping place on a major road.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbour where a ship halts during a voyage.

clue.text: Dessert wine may give one a minor jolt

parts.note: afters is British informal for dessert
hock is a German white wine

explanation.surface: Pudding wine might jolt someone a bit.
explanation.definitionFit: A smaller tremor following an earthquake.

clue.text: Like the bathroom I'd let out?

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are let loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: Asks whether a bathroom is something one would rent.

clue.text: A decisive game or performance cancelled

parts.note: a play is a theatrical performance
off means cancelled, as in the match is off

explanation.surface: Choosing between a deciding match or a scrapped show.
explanation.definitionFit: An extra match held to settle a tie or championship.

clue.text: Snap — or nip?

parts.note: nip read upwards in this down light gives the first part, with up added

explanation.surface: Asks whether to break or pinch.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' means written backwards: NIP up gives PIN UP.
explanation.definitionFit: A photograph of an attractive person pinned on a wall.

clue.text: Confederate states vessel

definitions.meaning: the nickname for the southern US states

explanation.surface: A ship belonging to the Southern side in the American Civil War.
explanation.definitionFit: Name of the American South, and a military mess tin or cooking pot.

clue.text: A girl artist has it framed

framed means the artist's letters surround the next piece like a picture frame

explanation.surface: A young woman painter has a picture framed.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name.

clue.text: Live with a university boyfriend

parts.note: to live is to be

explanation.surface: Moving in with a student partner.

clue.text: Arrangement not laid down?

definitions.meaning: placed upright rather than set down flat

explanation.surface: An arrangement that has not been prescribed.

clue.text: Hide away, or gradually let out

definitions.meaning: to discharge a substance, as glands do

explanation.surface: Choosing between concealing something and releasing it slowly.

clue.text: Identify unpleasant smell — but this won't cure anything

parts.note: to place someone is to identify them

explanation.definitionFit: A dummy pill with no active drug.

clue.text: Some magnetism maybe brings rose and Ted together

indicators.note: brought together hints the two names are combined and scrambled

clue.text: Applause is praise in the orchestra section

definitions.text: Applause is praise in the orchestra section

parts.words: Applause is praise in the orchestra section
parts.note: approval expressed by an audience clapping in the stalls

explanation.surface: Clapping counts as compliments from the audience.
explanation.definitionFit: An expression of enthusiastic approval.

clue.text: More work, repairing high-class patio

parts.note: U means upper-class

indicators.note: repairing fixes and reshapes the patio letters

explanation.surface: Extra labour on mending a fancy terrace.

explanation.definitionFit: Sir Thomas More's famous book about an ideal society.

clue.text: He's not the only one to succeed

definitions.text: He's not the only one to succeed

parts.words: He's not the only one to succeed
parts.note: someone who shares an inheritance with another person

clue.text: Measure of authority

parts.note: a football or cricket team has eleven players
a plus is an advantage

clue.text: It's not the key part of a fire-arm

parts.words: It's not the key part of a fire-arm

clue.text: Kind of milk no longer to be seen?

definitions.meaning: vanished like water into the air
